paragraphs.source_en: 1. Also present were David M. Abshire, CEO of the Center for the Study of the Presidency, former U.S. ambassador to NATO, and special counsel to President Reagan; Lieutenant General David W. Barno, former commander, Combined Forces Command in Afghanistan; Andrew Krepinevich, president of the CSBA, author of The Army and Vietnam, an analysis of U.S. strategy in Vietnam, and former member of the National Defense Panel and the Joint Forces Command’s Transformation Advisory Board; Andrew Marshall, director of the Department of Defense’s Office of Net Assessment; Captain Jan van Tol, CSBA senior fellow and former special assistant to the vice president and commander of the USS Essex; and Barry Watts, CSBA senior fellow, former air force officer, director of Northrop Grumman’s Analysis Center, and head of the DOD’s Office of Program Analysis and Evaluation. 2.
